acquisition method: Mass spectrometers were operated in the data-dependent mode
cleavage agent: three missed cleavages were allowed using trypsin/P as enzyme specificity.
collision energy: a maximum of 10 MS/MS scans were performed using a normalized collision energy of 25%
enrichment method: metal oxide affinity enrichment using titanium dioxide
Phosphopeptides were enriched by metal oxide affinity enrichment using titanium dioxide (GL Sciences Inc, Tokyo, Japan).
instrument: LC-MS/MS measurements were performed on a QExactive Plus mass spectrometer
ionization type: NanoESI spray voltage was set to 2.3 kV
labeling: The MS raw files were analyzed using MaxQuant Software version 1.4.1.2 for peak detection, quantification and peptide identification
reduction reagent: Assays were quenched by 8 M urea and 1 mM DTT.
reduction concentration: Assays were quenched by 8 M urea and 1 mM DTT.
